title: agent-crew task pipeline
description: Execution graph and stage progress for one task. Lives at {TASK_DIR}/pipeline.json. Written by analyst in Phase 1b; mutated by supervisor at each stage boundary. additionalProperties is true because analyst-emitted dynamic-agent entries and capability-gated fields (host_task_ids) are inherently open-ended.

schema_version.description: Optional in v1 — analyst-emitted pipeline.json may omit it (backward compat). Bumped on incompatible field changes.

task.description: Original task description (mirror of register.json.task; analyst writes this from its TASK input).

stages.description: 2D array. Each outer element is a sequential stage. Inner elements may be: (1) a bare string (legacy single-agent stage), (2) an array of strings (parallel-within-stage), or (3) an object {agents, tdd_parallel, parallelizable_units, streaming_review, qa_mode, qa_loop_target} (TDD parallel form, sub-task fan-out, streaming review, and/or QA planning/verification — see core/rules/state-files/pipeline-json.md for the per-flag semantics). Consumers normalize the three shapes. New mutating code implementation stages must use the object form with tdd_parallel=true; legacy bare code stages are schema-compatible but fail the planning-time quality gate.

agents.description: Agents in this stage. For newly planned mutating code work, a tdd_parallel stage must contain exactly one code implementer; split backend/frontend/custom implementers into separate TDD stages. The schema remains permissive for legacy state, but the planning-time quality gate rejects multi-implementer TDD stages.

tdd_parallel.description: When true, supervisor co-spawns the test-writer agent in parallel with every agent listed in `agents`. Both must complete before the stage advances. Mandatory for newly planned mutating code implementation stages. See core/agents/supervisor-stages.md § TDD Parallel Dispatch.

streaming_review.description: When true AND the next stage is a single `reviewer` agent, the supervisor co-spawns the reviewer in MODE=streaming alongside this stage's agent(s) in a single host message. The reviewer polls git log incrementally as new commits land, terminating once this stage's agent reports completed (with one final drain). On joint success, `completed_stages` advances by 2 — the trailing reviewer stage is consumed. Absent or false → existing sequential behavior. See core/agents/supervisor-stages.md § Streaming Review Dispatch.

requires_test_execution.description: Reviewer-stage opt-out (Issue #3). When true (default, absent), the reviewer EXECUTES the discovered test runner(s) in Phase 0/1 and runs the cross-process path agreement check in Phase 1.5 before approving. When false, the reviewer skips those phases and runs only the static review (the pre-Issue-#3 behavior) — appropriate only for docs-only / .gitignore-only / comment-only stages. Set ONLY on reviewer stage objects; supervisor reads it via stage.get('requires_test_execution', True). See core/agents/planner.md § Reviewer opt-out and core/rules/quality-loop.md § Quality Loop Enforcement (Issue #3).

qa_mode.description: QA owner stage mode. Use `plan` before implementation to create context/qa-test-cases.md and context/qa-plan.md. Use `verify` after an implementation/TDD stage and before a solo reviewer stage to execute the QA plan and emit QA_STATUS.

qa_loop_target.description: QA verification loop-back target. When a qa-owner verify stage returns QA_STATUS: needs_changes, `previous_implementation` tells the supervisor to re-enter the preceding implementation/TDD stage before QA and reviewer run again.

parallelizable_units.description: Optional. When length >= 2, the supervisor enters Sub-Task Fan-Out dispatch and spawns one agent-of-`agents[0]` per unit in a single host message. Absence or length <= 1 falls through to legacy single-agent / parallel / TDD dispatch — pre-existing pipelines are unaffected. See core/agents/supervisor-stages.md § Sub-Task Fan-Out Dispatch.

id.description: Short slug, unique within the stage (e.g. 'u1', 'orders', 'products'). Used as the unit key in stage_agent_status entries and progress event detail strings.

files.description: Shell-style file globs the unit will touch. Used by the planner's pre-flight overlap check and the supervisor's MVP conflict logger. May be empty when the unit creates a fresh subtree only.

brief.description: 1-2 sentence sub-task description handed to the unit's agent.

completed_stages.description: 0-based count of stages whose terminal state was successful completion. Resume logic skips stages with index < completed_stages.

needs_creation.description: Dynamic agents the planner determined must be created at Phase 1.5 before stage execution can begin. Empty array when all stages use builtin agents.

name.description: Agent filename without .md. Must match the name used in stages.

decision_context.description: Optional for legacy/non-mutating state. Required by the planning-time quality gate for newly planned mutating implementation work. Records Need Analyzer answers, ordered Capability Search, diff budget, Will Do, Will NOT Do, selected solution, and the reason new code is allowed.

stage_agent_status.description: Per-stage per-agent terminal status. Outer key is the 1-based stage index as a string; inner keys are agent names; inner values are completed | crashed | blocked. Written by supervisor-stages Phase 2 after each agent in a parallel stage reaches a terminal state.

host_task_ids.description: Capability-gated (task_tools=true). Parallel to stages: outer index = stage index, inner is {agent_name: host_task_id}. Populated by Phase 1c-bis. Absence is equivalent to DAG mirror disabled — every reader MUST tolerate.
